جاءَ: hollow and hamzated; imperative not attested
رَأَى: defective, hamzated; imperative رَ is rare
أَتَى: defective; Quranic imperative أْتِ after wa/fa
شاءَ: hollow and hamzated; no imperative in use
أَخَذَ: imperative drops hamza; attested 3MS/IND is passive
بِئْسَ: defective verb of censure; perfect only, no imperfect or imperative
رَدَّ: active رَدَّ يَرُدُّ given; attested forms are mostly passive (يُرَدُّ)
عَسَى: semi-auxiliary verb of hope; perfect only (عَسَى/عَسِيَ)
ساءَ: also used as verb of censure (be evil); imperative not used
أَذِنَ: active shown; attested 3MS indicative is passive (يُؤْذَنُ)
اسْتُهْزِئَ: passive of اِسْتَهْزَأَ (active: يَسْتَهْزِئُ, imp. اِسْتَهْزِئْ)
نِعْمَ: verb of praise (fi'l madh), perfect only; no imperfect or imperative
أَغْنَى: form IV; some attested forms (يَغْنَ) belong to غَنِيَ يَغْنَى
حَلَلْ: also حَلَّ يَحُلُّ (untie/alight), imp اُحْلُلْ, masdar حُلُولٌ
عَرَضَ: active imperfect not attested; also يَعْرُضُ in other senses
زالَت: kana-sister (ما زال), not زَالَ يَزُولُ; no imperative
حَىَّ: also حَيِيَ; attested يَحْيَىٰ same as pres
يَنۢبَغِي: used almost only in imperfect; attested يَنۢبَغِى same as pres
فَرَقْ: attested يَفْرَقُ is from فَرِقَ (to fear); imp attested ٱفْرُقْ same
تَقَرَّ: قَرَّتْ عَيْنُهُ; masdar uncertain; قَرْنَ is from a different verb
هاتُ: in practice only the imperative هَاتِ is used
طَفِقَ: aspectual verb; only perfect in Qur'an; imperfect uncertain
خاطَبَ: attested only as prohibitive تُخَاطِبْنِي; regular imperative given
يَطَّوَّفَ: Qur'anic يَطَّوَّفَ is the assimilated form of يَتَطَوَّفَ
يُهْرَعُ: passive (active form IV ahra'a, used only in passive)
يُغاثُ: passive (attested only passive; active aghatha yughithu)
دَنا: form I; imperfect attested only as IV yudni
يُنزَفُ: passive (active form IV أَنْزَفَ/يُنْزِفُ also attested)
تَبَّ: doubled verb; imperfect vowel per dictionary (يَتِبُّ also reported)
عَزَّ: here 'overpowered' (yaʿuzzu); 'be mighty' is ʿazza yaʿizzu, masdar ʿizzah
اتَّسَقَ: root وسق, assimilated و into ت
دَسَّى: defective II-type form of دَسَّسَ/دَسَا; masdar uncertain
تَلَظَّى: attested form is imperfect with dropped ت (أَصْلُهُ تَتَلَظَّى); defective
